material_class.structural_family: octanuclear polyoxo-polyselenido cluster; triangulated-dodecahedral Ln8(μ4-O)(μ3-OH)12 core

synthesis.procedure: Under dried Ar, a 100 mL flask was charged in a glove box with Se, K2Se (prepared from the elements in liquid ammonia), and GdCl3·6H2O, then attached to a Schlenk line and treated with dmf. The red-brown solution was stirred for 24 h, filtered through a fine frit, layered with diethyl ether, and left on vermiculite for several weeks. Crystals appeared within 1 week; material removed from solution often became an oil and was lightly pumped to a brown clay. Yields are approximate and are based on crystallized material relative to the rare-earth chloride. The μ4-O and OH ligands come from water in the hydrated chloride.
synthesis.time: stirred 24 h; crystals within 1 week; standing several weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 100 mL flask, Ar glove box then Schlenk line; filtration and ether layering
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered through a finely fritted glass filter, layered with 15 mL diethyl ether, and stored on vermiculite. Isolated crystals often turned to an oil; excess dmf was removed by light pumping to leave a brown clay. Analyses were performed on a mixture of clay and undissolved crystals.

material_class.structural_family: octanuclear polyoxo-polyselenido cluster; triangulated-dodecahedral Ln8(μ4-O)(μ3-OH)12 core with two chloro ligands replacing the Se3 ring of 1

synthesis.procedure: Prepared from a hydrated ytterbium trichloride, K2Se, and Se in dmf under the same general Ar/Schlenk conditions described as typical for compound 1. The paper does not give a separate numerical charge for the Yb reaction. The μ4-O and OH ligands are attributed to water in the hydrated chloride. Crystals were isolated after ether layering; the reported yield is approximate and based on crystallized material relative to the rare-earth chloride.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Ar glove box and Schlenk conditions, stated as typical of the synthesis of 1
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Isolation and crystallization are described only by reference to the typical procedure for 1 (filtration, diethyl ether layering, and standing).

source_locations.location: Abstract and discussion of the Ln8 core

material_class.structural_family: octanuclear polyoxo-polyselenido cluster; triangulated-dodecahedral Ln8(μ4-O)(μ3-OH)12 core with two chloro ligands in an isomeric arrangement relative to 2

synthesis.procedure: Prepared from a hydrated yttrium trichloride, K2Se, and Se in dmf under the conditions described as typical for compound 1. No separate numerical reagent charges or yield are given for the yttrium reaction. Elemental analyses do not match the crystallographic solvate formulation well, and cell checks of other crystals from the same reaction indicate at least one additional unidentified product.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Ar glove box and Schlenk conditions, stated as typical of the synthesis of 1
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystals were isolated from the reaction solution; the paper notes that compound 3 may not be the major isolated product and that another crystalline phase was present.
